title: Create a Nest.js backend that can serve users with wellness goals
description:
This project is a rewrite of an old backend system kept here for reference (DO NOT MODIFY) under `old-backend-reference` .

A Nest.js backend needs to be created that will be hosted on AWS EC2 and use AWS's Cognito for user auth, as well as Amazon's DynamoDB. We will want to still abstract away the UserAuth (Cognito) and database (DynamoDB) so that it's interfaced cleanly.

Apart from standard user operations to register, login, reset passwords etc (we only have password auth for now - no 2FA), a user will be able to do the following:
- edit their user profile (providing a partial UserProfile model)
- create a goal via standard input (providing a partial Goal model)
- create a goal via AI (provinding free form text)
- get goal suggestions (providing GoalType and GoalCategory and optional GoalDifficulty)

The second way of creating a goal - this accepts any text, which then will be passed to an AI service which will then return a list of suggested goals the user can choose from. For now the AI service should be left as dummy and will be implemented later (it's enough that it returns dummy data so the whole backend can work).

We need a database with a table for UserProfiles and a table for Goals so that the user can query and list them. Only the signed in user can see their own UserProfile and their Goals.

The user will also have a UserProfile that defines their biometric and such data. They can create it and edit it - it will become useful later.

The backend needs to produce a Swagger/OpenApi file that can be consumed by clients from which to generate their networking code for this backend. 

For all type-safety purposes use Prisma or an equivalent library to make sure that we are verifying inputs and outputs.

Include unit tests for all backend endpoints using appropriate mock data.

There also needs to be proper documentation (README.md) that would walk a user completely as to how to set up this backend on AWS + a Quickstart to launch it locally via docker. Use markdown links to link to other documents such as a [Database Info](/docs/DATABASE_INFO.md), [Docker Installation](/docs/DOCKER_INSTALLATION.md) or [Testing](/docs/TESTING.md) to explain the different parts of the backend and their dependencies, or how things work in more detail.

For now, we can assume the models look like this:

GoalType enum {
	MACRO, MICRO, OTHER
}
GoalCategory enum {
	FITNESS, SLEEP, FOCUS, STRESS, OTHER
}
GoalDifficulty enum {
	EASY, MEDIUM, HARD, OTHER
}
UserMood {
	score: number, 
	text?: string,
	createdAt: Date // auto generated on insert by BE
}
Goal {
	id: UUID, // auto generated by database on insert
	userId: UUID, // reference to the user
	type: GoalType,
	category: GoalCategory,
	difficulty: GoalDifficulty,
	text: string,
	moods: UserMood[],
	rating?: number, 
	createdAt: Date, // auto generated by database on insert
	updatedAt: Date, // auto generated by database on insert/update
	completedAt?: Date	
}

UserGender enum {
	MALE, FEMALE, OTHER
}
UserProfile {
	id: UUID, // auto generated by database on insert (should match the COGNITO id)
	dob?: string,
	gender?: UserGender
}

features.title: Setup Nest.js Project
features.description: Initialize a new Nest.js project using the Nest CLI. This will create the basic structure for the backend application, including the main module, controller, and service.

features.title: Configure Environment Variables
features.description: Set up a configuration module to manage environment variables for different environments (development, production). This will handle secrets and settings for AWS services (Cognito, DynamoDB) and other configurations.

features.title: Implement User Authentication with AWS Cognito
features.description: Create an authentication module that integrates with AWS Cognito for user registration, login, and password management. Implement an abstraction layer to decouple the application from Cognito-specific details.

features.title: Create User Profile Module
features.description: Develop a module for managing user profiles. This includes creating and updating a user's profile information, such as date of birth and gender. The user profile's ID should be linked to the Cognito user ID.

features.title: Integrate DynamoDB for Data Persistence
features.description: Set up the connection to Amazon DynamoDB. Implement a data access layer, possibly using the AWS SDK or a library like DynamoDB Toolbox, to interact with the UserProfiles and Goals tables. Define the data models and repositories.

features.title: Implement Goal Management Module
features.description: Create a module to handle CRUD operations for user goals. This includes endpoints for creating a goal from structured input, listing a user's goals, and updating/deleting goals. Ensure only the authenticated user can access their own goals.

features.title: Implement AI-Powered Goal Creation with a Mock Service
features.description: Create an endpoint that accepts free-form text to generate goals. This endpoint will call a mock AI service that returns a list of suggested goals. The mock service should be designed to be easily replaceable with a real AI service in the future.

features.title: Implement Goal Suggestion Endpoint
features.description: Develop an endpoint that provides goal suggestions based on type, category, and optional difficulty. This will initially return a predefined list of suggestions.

features.title: Generate OpenAPI/Swagger Documentation
features.description: Configure the Nest.js application to automatically generate an OpenAPI (Swagger) specification file. This will document all the available API endpoints, models, and operations, which can be used by frontend clients.

features.title: Write Unit Tests for All Endpoints
features.description: Implement unit tests for all controllers and services using a testing framework like Jest. Use mock data and mock services (e.g., for Cognito, DynamoDB, and the AI service) to ensure all endpoints are behaving as expected.

features.title: Containerize the Application with Docker
features.description:
Create a `Dockerfile` to containerize the Nest.js application and a `docker-compose.yml` file to facilitate local development, including any necessary services like a local DynamoDB instance.
Also update @docs/DOCKER_INSTALLATION.md if need be.

features.title: Create Comprehensive Project Documentation
features.description: Write a detailed `README.md` file with instructions for setting up the project locally and on AWS. Create separate markdown files (`docs/DATABASE_INFO.md`, `docs/DOCKER_INSTALLATION.md`, `docs/TESTING.md`) with in-depth information about the database schema, Docker setup, and testing procedures.

features.title: Update all docs to have proper markup links
features.description:
Make sure that all links inside documentation follow standard markup internal links ie:
[Name](/link) so to link somewhere in a doc to @README.md - write: [README.md](/README.md) .
All the documentation under `docs` should be updated accordingly and the @README.md

features.title: Add weight and height to the UserProfile attributes
features.description:
We need to end up storing:
weight (number), weight_raw (string), height (number), height_raw (string)

where the user will input weight_raw and height_raw as strings, but based on the values we should try to guess what unit it is, and store weight in kgs and height in cms.
